items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 4.7% in 1985 to 7.1% in 2025 across 38 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

13 of 38 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 1 for salt or chloride; 4 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 38 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 8 of 8 high-need ones have none.
